optimizedDescription.value: Hexagonal + DDD: domain center, I/O at edges. domain/application/infrastructure/composition layers for all business-logic packages.

optimizedContext.value:
# Architecture

## Rules
- Business-logic packages: `domain` / `application` / `infrastructure` + optional `composition/`; inner layers never import outer
- `domain/`: zero I/O (no fs/net/child_process/HTTP); stdlib + domain types only
- `application/`: outside world via ports in `application/ports/` only; never import infrastructure
- Rich entities: own invariants + state transitions; throw typed domain errors; use cases don't duplicate entity checks
- Value objects: behaviour via methods/getters; internal representation not exposed outside class hierarchy
- Ports with shared constructor args: `abstract class` (not interface); invariant fields in constructor; all methods explicit (no property signatures)
- Stateless domain services: plain functions in `domain/services/`, not classes
- Manual DI at entry points; no IoC; constructors receive port implementations
- `composition/`: only layer importing `infrastructure/`; wires Kernel + config loader/writer ports
- Kernel: `createKernel(config, options?)` wires use cases; no config mutation in kernel; hosts read via `kernel.project.getConfig`
- Every Kernel capability MUST be obtainable without `createKernel`; factories: `createX(deps)` canonical, `createX(config, options?)` convenience via shared composition-resolver
- `createKernel`/`createKernelBuilder`: convenience over same resolver path; not second composition source of truth
- Concrete adapters never exported from public entry points; delivery hosts (`@specd/cli`, `@specd/mcp`) import `@specd/sdk` per `sdk:composition`
- Infrastructure YAML reads: validate at boundary with schema validator; failures as `ConfigValidationError`/`SchemaValidationError` extending `SpecdError`
- Adapter packages (`@specd/cli`, `@specd/mcp`, `@specd/plugin-*`): no business logic; translate delivery ↔ use cases
- Package deps one-way: `plugin-*` → `skills` → `core`; `cli` → `sdk`; `mcp` → `sdk`; `sdk` → `core`, `code-graph`; `schema-*` no specd deps
- Public barrels via `package.json` exports: `"."` integrator surface (no concrete adapters); `"./ports"` port contracts; `"./extensions"` kernel registry/factory types; `"./internal"` dev-only
- `@specd/sdk` re-exports `./ports` and `./extensions` from `@specd/core`

## Constraints
- domain/ must not import application/, infrastructure/, composition/
- application/ must not import infrastructure/, composition/
- infrastructure/ must not import composition/
- Only composition/ imports infrastructure/; no concrete adapters from index.ts
- Delivery: use factories/kernel/config ports only; no infrastructure imports or direct use-case construction
- No module-level singletons; constructor DI everywhere
- Domain errors extend SpecdError; stateless ops are functions not classes
- Ports with invariant ctor args are abstract classes with explicit methods
- No circular workspace:* dependencies
- YAML validated at infrastructure boundary before domain/application
- Public "." barrels: no concrete adapters; must export kernel-equivalent createX factories
- Port contracts on `@specd/core/ports` + `@specd/sdk/ports`; extensions on `/extensions`
- cli/mcp MUST NOT depend on both `@specd/core` and `@specd/code-graph` when `@specd/sdk` suffices
